how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the Institute's website.
Fill in the form and attach self-attested proofs of educational and other qualifications, age proof etc.
Attach APARs/ACR for last five years attested by the Competent Authority, Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate.
Get the parent department to certify the official will be relieved within the stipulated period if selected.
Forward the application through proper channel to the Principal, SIHMCT, Thuvakkudi, Tiruchirappalli within 30 days from publication of the advertisement.
Make sure it reaches by 5 December 2026.
important_instructions: Application form without self-certified supporting documents liable to be treated as invalid Institute reserves the right to withdraw/cancel/modify the notification

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SIHMCT Trichy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SIHMCT Trichy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Administrative Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SIHMCT Trichy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application form, downloadable from the Institute's website; also printed with this notice) and send it to The Principal, State Institute of Hotel Management and Catering Technology, Thuvakkudi, Tiruchirappalli- 620 015, Tamilnadu, by through proper channel, to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on 25 October 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PB-2 Rs.36900-135100 with Grade Pay 4800 (revised scale).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate with 5 years experience in administration and establishment matters; officers holding analogous posts in Central Government, State Government, Quasi-Government Organizations or PSUs. Desirable: Knowledge of Computers.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Officer must hold an analogous post in Central Government, State Government, Quasi-Government Organization or PSU. Must be eligible for deputation as per Recruitment Rules of SIHMCT-Trichy and Government of Tamilnadu instructions.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after the prescribed last date. Applications not forwarded through proper channel.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Personal interview. Personal interview; no TA/DA paid for appearing.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation initially for 2 years. Can be extended up to one additional year subject to clearance of the Board of Governors, SIHMCT, Trichy.
